title: Technical SEO fixes (meta, headings, anchors, schema, canonical, Open Graph) with zero visual/layout changes

requirements.text: Update the site-level SEO meta tags in frontend/index.html to exactly match the provided Meta Title and Meta Description, without affecting UI appearance.

quotes:
1. Set SEO Meta:
- Meta Title: "Gadget Zone | Mobile Store in Thiruvanmiyur Chennai"
- Meta Description: "Gadget Zone is a trusted mobile store in Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai for smartphones, accessories, repairs, EMI options & CCTV solutions."

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <title> is exactly "Gadget Zone | Mobile Store in Thiruvanmiyur Chennai"

frontend/index.html contains a single <meta name="description"> with content exactly "Gadget Zone is a trusted mobile store in Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai for smartphones, accessories, repairs, EMI options & CCTV solutions."
No visible layout or styling changes occur (meta-only changes)

requirements.text: Fix heading semantics in the React page content so there is exactly one H1 with text "Gadget Zone", and use H2 tags for the main sections: "Brands We Deal With", "Products & Services", "Why Choose Us", "HOT PICK", and "Store Gallery". Use H3 only inside sections if needed, and do not change any displayed text content, styling, or section order.

quotes:
2. Fix Heading Semantics:
- Assign exactly ONE H1: "Gadget Zone"
- Assign H2 tags to main sections:
  - Brands We Deal With
  - Products & Services
  - Why Choose Us
  - HOT PICK
  - Store Gallery
- Use H3 only inside sections if needed
- Do not change text content or visual styling

acceptanceCriteria: Rendered DOM contains exactly one <h1> and its text content is exactly "Gadget Zone"

Each listed main section title is rendered as an

No additional <h1> elements exist anywhere on the page

requirements.text: Add internal anchor links for in-page navigation without changing layout: (a) each Product & Service card links to its respective description section, (b) the HOT PICK button links to the HOT PICK content section, and (c) the footer includes anchor links to Products, Services, and Contact.

quotes:
3. Add Internal Anchor Links:
- Product & Service cards should link to their respective description sections
- HOT PICK button should link to the HOT PICK content section
- Footer should include anchor links to Products, Services, and Contact

acceptanceCriteria: Each service description section has a stable id attribute (e.g., derived from the service name) and clicking its corresponding card updates the URL hash and scrolls to that section
The floating HOT PICK control includes a real anchor target (href to the HOT PICK section id) and still scrolls to the HOT PICK section when activated
Footer contains visible links that navigate via hash anchors to Products, Services, and Contact sections (no route changes)
All anchor additions preserve existing styles and do not reflow or reorder content

requirements.text: Add LocalBusiness structured data (JSON-LD) to frontend/index.html (or another static head injection approach) including: Business Name (Gadget Zone), Address (Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu), Phone number and WhatsApp, Business hours, and Services offered, without affecting UI appearance.

quotes:
4. Add LocalBusiness Schema (Structured Data):
Include:
- Business Name: Gadget Zone
- Address: Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
- Phone number & WhatsApp
- Business hours
- Services offered

acceptanceCriteria: A single JSON-LD <script type="application/ld+json"> is present in the document head
Schema type is LocalBusiness (or a more specific subtype if already used) and includes name "Gadget Zone"
Schema includes address with locality "Chennai" and region "Tamil Nadu" and references Thiruvanmiyur
Schema includes the phone number and a WhatsApp contact URL/identifier based on existing site values (+919840077591 and 919840077591 as used in the UI)
Schema includes business hours matching the UI (10 AM – 9 PM)
Schema includes a list of services offered aligned with the existing Products/Services content
No visible UI changes occur

requirements.text: Add a canonical link tag in frontend/index.html pointing to the main site URL using the non-www version. Use the homepage URL already used in frontend/public/sitemap.xml as the canonical href.

quotes:
5. Add Canonical Link:
- Set canonical URL to the main site URL (non-www version)

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html contains exactly one <link rel="canonical">
Canonical href equals "https://gadgetzone-nz9.caffeine.xyz/" (non-www) as per frontend/public/sitemap.xml
No visible UI changes occur

requirements.text: Add Open Graph tags in frontend/index.html for social sharing, including og:title, og:description, and og:image, using the provided title/description and an existing site image asset (do not regenerate images).

quotes:
6. Add Open Graph Tags:
- Title, description, and preview image for social sharing

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Do NOT regenerate images

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html includes og:title matching "Gadget Zone | Mobile Store in Thiruvanmiyur Chennai"
frontend/index.html includes og:description matching the provided meta description exactly

frontend/index.html includes og:image referencing an existing image already in the project (no new image generation) and uses an absolute URL when possible (e.g., canonical base + existing asset path)
No visible UI changes occur

constraints: Do not move sections or change section order.
Do not modify hero text or hero layout.
Do not change any visible design, styling, spacing, or layout; SEO changes must not affect UI appearance.
Do not regenerate or modify images; only reference existing assets.
Do not change text content other than the specified meta title/description and the semantic HTML tag names needed for headings/anchors.
nonGoals: Changing analytics, GA4/GTM behavior, or tracking events (except incidental hash navigation from anchor links).
Backend changes (backend/main.mo should remain untouched for this request).
Content rewrites of section copy, service descriptions, or hero messaging.

preferencesToAdd: Prefer technical SEO changes that do not alter visual design or layout.
